book.title: Cama Tsǝtsǝfǝ Nǝ Bulusu Anǝ Njir Afisa

content: Ta hyi ɗa wazha kǝra Hyal wu yiwu, kǝl hya faˈabiya hi culi nggyabiya nǝ Hyal.
Hya nggya nggyabiya nǝ yiwudzǝ ǝnggǝr kǝra Kǝrsiti cabiya mǝn yiwudzau, kǝl ta ji lǝr kǝrnyi arya mǝn, ar viya sǝ lǝlǝ kǝra kisu ǝnga saɗaka anǝ Hyal.
Ama wu pama hyi, nja sara nggari alaga ǝnga ǝngwa abǝr nju mǝl sǝsukur, ǝnga kalar culi sǝ zhizhigǝr, ǝnga suna mai, arya aˈyi kyau anǝ nji cici nǝ Hyal mai.
Abangǝ tsu ndǝr gǝra sǝli, ǝnga ndǝr hyahya, ǝnga ndǝr dzadza, aˈyi a ki ǝnga hyi mai. Ar viya kǝ hya dumwa ǝnga usaku anǝ Hyal.
Ara pakatǝ hyu sǝni, abǝr ndǝr mǝl sǝsukur, ǝnga ndǝr nggya zhizhigǝr, ǝnga ndǝr toma, ndǝra kakal nga ja ǝnga ndǝr nu katǝu, nanda aˈyi wu uya faˈa ki ǝnga tǝlkur Kǝrsiti ǝnga Hyal mai.
Vanyi ndǝ ja sara nggutana hyi ǝnga ndǝr papatagǝ mai, arya culi nggyabiya kǝ ngǝ huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ nǝ Hyal wu shili ar kǝra njira gǝra ɓǝlar ndǝr nyi.
Agabangau, hya sara daɓǝ kǝr ǝnga nda mai.
Ara ɗǝɗǝm wu kuthlǝ nga hyi, ama kabangǝkau, a uyar hyi mbǝmbǝlkur lagur Thlagǝu. Nahyi, hya nggya ar viya nji mbǝmbǝl.
Arya mbǝmbǝl kau, ngu shili ǝnga thlǝr mǝnahǝu, ǝnga nggya tsapǝu, ǝnga nggya jijiri.
Hya gal lagura hya daɓaga pina huɗa Thlagǝ ari.
Hya tǝkǝbiya dzau ǝnga thlǝr kuthlǝ kǝra gǝra kǝtiya hyi, kuji hya mǝliya ja ɗa ar babal.
Ara wu ɗa sǝ sǝsǝli ma nja ndǝr ar kǝra sǝra ndu mǝl ar ɗǝwa.
Ar pǝcira nji dla ǝnga kalar sǝ wu mwar mbǝmbǝl, kalar sǝ wu ɗa ar babal.
Arya mbǝmbǝl ngǝ wu mǝliya kalar sǝ ja ɗa ar babal. Ca ngǝ sǝra ɗa ji na,

content.text: “Hyaˈari wu ghanyi nagǝ ndǝra wu ghanyi,
ba Kǝrsiti a mbǝlna mbǝmbǝl nyi a gyar gau.”

content: Agabangau, hya nggya ǝnga hangǝkal wu nggyabiyar hyi. Hya sara nggya ǝnggǝr nji dza mai, ama hya ɗa nji hahangǝu.
Hya mǝl thlǝr ǝnga kalar pǝci kǝra hyi uya aga mǝl sǝ mǝnahǝu, ara pǝci kǝra mǝn a gwa kau, pǝci ɗǝmwaˈyi ngau.
Agabangau, hya sara ɗa nji dza mai, ama hya sǝnbiya sǝr yiwu huɗa Thlagǝu.
Hya sara nyi ǝnga padlǝ mai, kǝra wu mǝliya hya ɗa njir cim mǝl yambaɗǝkur. Ama hya kyaga nyabiya dzǝ ǝnga Mambǝl Hyal.
Hya ndǝr wu pama hyi sara wu Zabura, ǝnga hya na sara wu lǝkakaɗǝ na, ǝnga na mambǝl mambǝl. Hya dumwa ǝnga na nǝ fal Thlagǝu ǝnga ɗǝfuwa hyi papatǝu.
Ənga cumu hya lǝr usaku ar kǝra kalar sǝ anǝ Hyal Tada wu thlǝmǝr Yesu Kǝrsiti Thlagǝr mǝn.
Hya lǝr kǝrhyi anǝ kuvwar hyi wu lagur gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ Kǝrsiti.
Shili Ənga Mathlǝkǝˈyi
Nahyi mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝra ǝnga shili, hya lǝr kǝrhyi anǝ shilǝr hyi ǝnggǝr anǝ Thlagǝu.
Ara sal ngǝ kǝra mala nyi, ǝnggǝr kǝra Kǝrsiti ngǝ kǝra daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu nyi. Naja ǝnga kǝrnyi ngǝ ndǝr mbǝɗa daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu nyi kǝra ca ngǝ dza ja.
Ənggǝr kǝra daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu wu lǝr kǝr anǝ Kǝrsiti, abangǝ tsu nahyi mathlǝkǝˈyi hya lǝr kǝrhyi anǝ shilǝr hyi, wu kalar sau.
Nahyi shili, hya canǝ nyi yiwukur anǝ mathlǝkǝˈyir hyi ǝnggǝr kǝra Kǝrsiti canǝ nyi anǝ daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu nyi. Ji lǝri piya ja ar viya ja,
aga nda ɗa nji cici anǝ Hyal lagur cina nda ǝnga ˈyimi lagur ndǝr Hyal.
Ji mǝliya abangǝ aga ar pǝcira ju nda lǝr daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu anǝ kǝrnyi, ndu ɗa nji gumaguma kǝra ji cina casǝu, gǝra diɗi alaga hahashau, ama cici ǝnga gǝra vazau wu mwa nyi.
Abangǝ tsu, ngǝ shili, a ca yiwukur anǝ mathlǝkǝˈyir nda, ǝnggǝr kǝra ndu yiwu dza nda. Kalar ndǝra canǝ nyi yiwukur anǝ mala nyi, kǝrnyi nga ju yiwu.
Ara ndǝr piyari shishir dza kǝrnyi aˈyi mai, ama ja pabǝri dza ja ǝnga ja nǝ nyi sǝr sǝm, ǝnggǝr kǝra Kǝrsiti wu pabǝ dza daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu nyi.
Ara namǝn ngǝ gashal gashal dza ja.
Ənggǝr kǝra ja tsǝtsǝfau, abǝr,

content.text: “Arya abangau, ndǝ sal wu piyari dǝnyi ǝnga mǝnyi,
nda ɗa sǝ zǝmǝ ǝnga mala nyi, nanda mǝthlǝ ndu ɗa ar viya ndǝ zǝmǝu.”

content: Sǝkǝ sǝ ɗǝɗǝwa ngǝ kǝra dzadzau ara nggabiya. Ama ya vǝr ndǝr, aga ya cabiya sǝra wu pama Kǝrsiti ǝnga daɓǝ dzǝ njir nu nyi.
Agabangau, kalar ndǝ sal, ja cabiya yiwukur anǝ mala nyi ǝnggǝr kǝra ju yiwu kǝrnyi, ǝnga kalar mala tsu, ja gǝnggǝr nyi sǝli anǝ sal nyi.
